verdict.rationale: Numeral documents continuous nexus monitoring across US and global jurisdictions, and its MCP tools expose per-jurisdiction economic thresholds alongside current sales and transaction counts, so the tracking half of the story is covered. The only documented alerting is 'when you cross nexus in new jurisdictions', which is at or after crossing, not before as the story requires. Missing for 10: documented pre-threshold or approaching-threshold alerts, detail on alert channels and configurable warning levels, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the product watches my economic nexus exposure — tracking sales and transaction counts against every state and country threshold and alerting me before I cross one, not after
